Department: Gastroenterology / Hepatology

Prioritize:
- abdominal distension, bowel obstruction patterns, vomiting character, stool history, jaundice, and rectal findings;
- anatomic versus functional distal obstruction;
- tests that separate Hirschsprung disease, meconium ileus, and atresia.

Watch for:
- over-reassurance from a normal ultrasound;
- missing delayed meconium passage as a decisive neonatal clue.
